given: The team member is on the file-stock screen and no stock record yet exists for a given (sku, location) pair
when: They submit a filing with a valid sku, location, non-negative quantity, and inventory_code for that pair
then: The stock record is persisted carrying all four values and a confirmation of the filed record is shown
architectural_notes: Full write path: file-stock UI submit -> app/routes boundary -> StockService (owns create-or-update) -> StockRepository (only ORM layer) -> Stock model, asserting persisted branch state plus the rendered confirmation, so E2E. Required fields sku/location/quantity/inventory_code are NOT NULL (PI2); audit fields (created_at/actor, R1) are service-set.
